answers.genPolicy:62a70820afa59e9a865d5069f2e058:
[B1] < UserX | 'near' : nils , ... > $ UserX 'approach' deviceB
=> < UserX | 'near' : deviceB , ... > .
[B2] < UserX | 'near' : deviceB , ... > $ UserX 'leave' deviceB
=> < UserX | 'near' : nils , ... > .
[B3] < deviceB | 'owner' : nils , 'online' : false , 'key' : Key , ... > $ UserX 'pressButton' deviceB
=> < deviceB | 'owner' : nils , 'online' : true , 'key' : Key , 'button' : true , ... > $ deviceB 'sendKey' UserX | (Key) .
[B3] < UserX | 'key' : nils , ... > $ deviceB 'sendKey' UserX | (Key)
=> < UserX | 'key' : Key , ... > .
[B4] < UserX | 'key' : Key , ... > < deviceB | 'owner' : nils , 'online' : true , 'key' : Key , ... > < cloudA | deviceB : ('owner' : nils , 'key' : Key , ...) > $ UserX 'callAPI:bind' cloudA | (deviceB ; Key)
=> < UserX | 'key' : Key , ... > < deviceB | 'owner' : UserX , 'online' : true , 'key' : Key , ... > < cloudA | deviceB : ('owner' : UserX , 'key' : Key , ...) > .
[B5] < UserX | 'key' : Key , ... > < cloudA | deviceB : ('owner' : UserX , ...) > $ UserX 'callAPI:reset' cloudA | (deviceB)
=> < UserX | 'key' : Key , ... > < cloudA | deviceB : ('owner' : nils , ...) > $ cloudA 'reset' deviceB .
[B5] < deviceB | 'online' : true , 'owner' : Owner, ... > $ cloudA 'reset' deviceB
=> < deviceB | 'online' : false , 'owner' : nils , ... > .
